features.title: Projects and chat threads
features.acceptance: Projects hold multiple threads; history persists and is searchable.

features.title: Clarifying questions
features.acceptance: Standard/Deep runs ask at most 3 skippable clarifying questions.

features.title: Plan review
features.acceptance: Editable plan (sub-questions, sources, effort, cost estimate) approved/edited/cancelled before Standard/Deep runs.

features.title: Effort levels
features.acceptance: Quick/Standard/Deep limits enforced in code.

features.title: Live run view
features.acceptance: Agent to tool tree with status, time, tokens and cost, streamed over AG-UI.

features.title: Run control
features.acceptance: Pause, resume, cancel and branch-and-rerun from a checkpoint; runs survive restart.

features.title: Budgets
features.acceptance: Pre-run estimate with confirm above threshold; wrap-up at 80%, graceful stop at 100% keeping partial results.

features.title: Citation chips
features.acceptance: Inline [n] chips show the quote on hover and open the reader at the passage on click.

features.title: Multi-source search

features.title: Identity resolution and dedupe
features.acceptance: Records merge across sources by IDs, then by fuzzy title+year+first author.

features.title: Explainable ranking
features.acceptance: Per-paper score breakdown with Balanced/Seminal/Recent presets.

features.title: Coverage indicator
features.acceptance: Completeness estimate from the discovery-rate curve with a search-more action.

features.title: Saved searches and alerts
features.acceptance: Scheduled re-runs surface new papers in an inbox.

features.title: Collections, tags, notes
features.acceptance: Per-project collections, tags, notes and highlights.

features.title: Legal OA full text
features.acceptance: Full text fetched only from legal OA locations; license stored per paper.

features.title: Parsing pipeline
features.acceptance: Papers parsed into sections, figures, tables, equations and references.

features.title: PDF reader with passage jump

features.title: Import/export and Zotero

features.title: Multi-level summaries

features.title: Equation/figure/table explanations

features.acceptance: Answers pass layered citation verification.

features.title: Paper comparison

features.title: Contradiction finder

features.title: Gaps and trends
features.acceptance: Trend charts, rare-link gaps and thin sub-questions.

features.acceptance: Prior and derivative works plus co-citation and coupling similarity.

features.title: Timeline
features.acceptance: Timeline view of papers and concepts.

features.acceptance: Expand on click, filters, Louvain clusters, in-graph search, pin to collection.

features.title: Field view

features.title: In-answer visuals

features.title: Research notebook
features.acceptance: Block document with sandboxed executable code cells.

features.title: Block editor with AI edits
features.acceptance: Plate editor with AI rewrite, expand, condense, cite-this and comments.
